preconditions: Refresh exact product snapshots and compare identities to the prepared baseline.
Confirm all new M03/M04/M05 keys and native 4000000905 are absent.
Confirm M06 uses two distinct existing test-owned cards.
The source of M01 must still be price=1, quantity=0, presence=not_available.
Hosted file bytes must match sha256.
stages.acceptance: Evaluate each row separately. M01 and M02 must update their exact existing native IDs. M03 must create exactly one card. M04/M05/M06/M07 are diagnostic edge cases, so global created/updated counts are not predeclared.

preconditions: Finish stage 09, save all row results and complete cleanup first.
M01 and M02 resolved to their original native IDs with no unexplained duplicate.
M03 key exists, maps uniquely to its recorded new native ID, and its card is owned by this test.
Refresh snapshots and reconcile metadata after cleanup.
Do not submit the complete static stage-10 file if M03 did not create a verified owned card.
stages.acceptance: All three rows update their recorded native IDs with the new CSV 10 texts and create zero new cards. A separate identical replay may be skipped by Prom; it must still create no duplicate.

stages.route: Manual Prom cabinet import with Только обновление explicitly enabled
preconditions: The G02 key and native 4000000911 are still absent.
Use the documented manual checkbox; the tested public is_import_v2 parameter is not a verified equivalent.
stages.acceptance: G01 receives all four CSV 11 texts. G02 creates no card. A rejected whole import or unchanged G01 cannot establish update-only behavior.

required_readback: Exact native IDs and import keys, including lookup of new keys and a test-marker scan to detect duplicates with empty keys.
Both titles and both descriptions for every processed row.
Price, quantity, presence, SKU, currency, measure unit, group, category, gallery, discount and visibility compared before cleanup.
For M06, read both existing native IDs and any new card with the case marker.
Read actual data rather than treating launch status or updated counters as proof.
cleanup: Persist all observed changes before restoring anything.
Hide test-owned creations and re-read their hidden status.
If M01 price/quantity/presence changed, restore all three using supported editing and verify exact baseline values before stage 10.
Record and restore other unintended changes to existing test fixtures where a supported write is available; do not silently label them preserved.
A successful M04 adoption is an explicit experimental result: preserve the original native ID, record the assigned key, and do not pretend its external_id stayed null.
Do not permanently delete products, modify unrelated products, mutate the internal catalog or schedule periodic imports.
scope_limits: M07 deliberately violates the documented required import-key rule.
Stage-09 M01 is adversarial for price, quantity and presence. M07 separately sends a blank SKU. Gallery is not varied in the input, so its unchanged state alone does not prove filtering.
The files do not contain intentionally broken headers, missing measure units, oversized texts or duplicate keys inside one batch; those failures would confound identity tests.
A native-ID-preserving round trip of a genuine Prom CSV export remains a separate experiment requiring an actual export artifact.
Preparation is not execution: expected outcomes are criteria, not claimed results.
M02 and the repeated M03 intentionally omit an existing product native ID to test external-key-only matching; the CSV documentation requires native IDs for existing products.
M07 sends an empty SKU to exclude SKU-based fallback. Its existing SKU must remain TEST under a text-only field list; capture any change separately.
